entries.title: State of the art in software verification and witness validation
entries.key_innovation: Introduces SV-COMP 2024 witness format 2.0 and a new validation scoring schema for comparing software verification and witness validation tools.

entries.title: SV-COMP 2024
entries.key_innovation: Reports the SV-COMP 2024 software verification competition, comparing verification tools on standardized C and Java benchmark tasks.

entries.title: SV-COMP 2023
entries.key_innovation: Reports the SV-COMP 2023 software verification competition, evaluating tools on reachability, memory safety, overflow, and termination tasks.

entries.title: Towards neural decompilation
entries.key_innovation: Proposes neural network-based decompilation to translate binary code into high-level source code, reducing reliance on handcrafted decompilation patterns.

entries.title: Unsupervised translation of programming languages
entries.key_innovation: Presents unsupervised translation of programming languages without aligned parallel corpora by learning cross-language representations.

entries.title: Program translation via code distillation
entries.key_innovation: Proposes Code Distillation (CoDist), using a language-agnostic intermediate representation as a translation pivot across programming languages without aligned data.

entries.title: LLM4Decompile
entries.key_innovation: Introduces LLM4Decompile, the first open-source large language model series trained to decompile binaries directly and refine Ghidra output, improving re-executability.

entries.title: Relogix Assembler-to-C translator
entries.key_innovation: Automated translation of assembly code into C source code via decompilation-oriented transformation.

entries.title: Boomerang open source decompiler
entries.key_innovation: Open-source decompiler translating machine code into high-level C using static analysis and dataflow recovery.

entries.title: Highly automated formal proofs over memory usage of assembly code
entries.key_innovation: Generates pre/postconditions, invariants, and memory layout assumptions to automate interactive theorem proving of assembly memory usage bounds.

entries.title: A tool for formal verification of DSP assembly language programs
entries.key_innovation: A formal verification tool for DSP assembly language programs using automated reasoning or proof checking.

entries.title: Modular verification of SPARCv8 code
entries.key_innovation: Modular formal verification methodology for SPARCv8 assembly code using compositional program analysis or refinement.

entries.title: Some assembly required-program analysis of embedded system code
entries.key_innovation: Integrates model-checking based static analysis of embedded ARM assembly with C/C++ code and automatically checks assembly interface compliance.

entries.title: Machine-code verification for multiple architectures-an application of decompilation into logic
entries.key_innovation: Uses proof-producing decompilation into logic to make machine-code verification tractable and enable proof reuse across ARM, PowerPC, and x86.

entries.title: Verification method of safety properties of embedded assembly program by combining SMT-Based bounded model checking and reduction of interrupt handler executions
entries.key_innovation: Combines SMT-based bounded model checking with interrupt handler execution reduction and fixed-width bit-vector modeling to verify embedded assembly safety properties.

entries.title: CompCertM
entries.key_innovation: Introduces RUSC, Refinement Under Self-related Contexts, a lightweight compositional verification technique for verified multi-language linking of C and assembly in CompCert.

entries.title: K semantics for assembly languages
entries.key_innovation: Defines a modular MIPS assembly language semantics in the K framework with pluggable memory models usable by program verification tools.

entries.title: Simple relational correctness proofs for static analyses and program transformations
entries.key_innovation: Interprets program properties as relations instead of predicates, enabling simple denotational correctness proofs for static analyses and transformations like dead-code elimination, constant propagation, slicing, and secure information flow.

entries.title: Proving and disproving equivalenceˇ of functional programming assignments
entries.key_innovation: Automated equivalence checking for functional programming assignments that handles recursion via functional induction, auxiliary functions via call matching, and scales by clustering submissions using transitivity of equivalence.

entries.title: The S <scp>LAM</scp> project
entries.key_innovation: A static analysis toolkit that checks C programs against API usage rules by inferring invariants without annotations and using counterexample-driven refinement to reduce false positives.

entries.title: Case Study Research in Software Engineering
entries.key_innovation: Provides methodology for conducting case study research in software engineering, covering design, data collection, and analysis.

entries.title: Belief &amp
entries.key_innovation: Case study examining developers' prior beliefs at Microsoft and their relationship to empirical project data, finding strong beliefs primarily formed from personal experience.

entries.title: Formal Methods
entries.key_innovation: Introduces formal methods for specifying and verifying software systems using mathematical models.
